No security preference or recovery outcome is supplied here. |","new":"| CP-3C / refinancing and liability-management risk | Use historical funding access, maturity management, distribution financing and secured/subordinated changes to frame refinancing and liability-management risk. | Obtain current refinancing/market evidence, hedging and cash-access inputs; obtain executed terms and CP-4 legal interpretation before dependent conclusions. Historical access is not future feasibility, and no LME, security preference or recovery outcome is established here. |"},{"old":"| CP-4 / committee synthesis | Use Assessment, Thesis, priority findings, ranked strengths/weaknesses, conditional downside chain and contrary evidence. | Keep Medium confidence, historical date and missing-evidence qualifications. Do not convert the governance rubric or profile into a rating/composite. |","new":"| CP-4 / legal and covenant interpretation | Use the Gaps legal-capacity row, distribution financing, secured/subordinated changes and reported compliance context to frame what the legal/covenant package actually permits. | Obtain and analyze executed agreements, indentures/amendments, certificates, baskets and guarantor/collateral schedules before capacity, headroom, control or protection conclusions. Annual disclosure and historical execution do not establish contractual permission. |"},{"old":"| CP-6 / monitoring context | Use the observable revenue, margin, cash, liquidity, leverage, refinancing, shareholder-action and sector signals. | Obtain dated follow-up evidence for later-period judgments; do not imply a committee action bias or a current event from the historical record. |","new":"| CP-6 / investment-committee debate and challenge | Challenge Assessment, Thesis, priority findings, ranked strengths/weaknesses, conditional downside chain and contrary evidence; use observable monitoring signals to frame debate. | Keep Medium confidence, historical date and missing-evidence qualifications; obtain dated follow-up evidence for later-period judgments. Do not convert the governance rubric or profile into a rating/composite. Committee debate and any action bias remain downstream, not supplied by this historical synthesis. |"}]}
